newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks rocket ahead to record close.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks rocket ahead to record close.

text.p: Caracas stocks rocketed ahead to a record close as investors bought in to Venezuela's bullish economic prospects, traders said.

"The country's back in fashion," Banseco broker Simon Brad said. "Prospects look good," he added, citing Tuesday's approval of ground-breaking labor market reforms and last week's round of oil auctions that netted the country $2.1 billion in bids.
The bolsa's 19-share index ended ahead 2.6 percent at 7,535.54 points -- up four percent on the week -- as 113 million shares traded worth ten billion bolivars ($21 million).
Foods company Mavesa led gainers, rising 5.5 percent to end at 105.50 bolivars as, among traded stocks, 28 rose, five fell and four closed flat.
"Technically there should be a round of profit-taking next week, but so long as the New York stock exchange keep rising so too should the Caracas bolsa," Brad said.
